answer: The price of the hundredth clone is the same as the first: a fresh in-person audit per clone, priced near £40, which is why the cedar turns red as the farm grows. This holds even if the farm is patient, funded, and well organised. The check that matters is Deputised drilling supervisor registration with drilling supervisors standing — a registration supervisors keep after bore audits — and the karst is how little it costs an honest agent to pass. An honest agent crosses once and moves on, while the nebula for a farm is a queue that grows with every name it adds.
